axes: arrays (ny, nx); row 0 = south, col 0 = west; +x east, +y north
nodata: coverage==0 cells are UNKNOWN: ground, top, height and uncertainty are NaN there and the cell is not a zero-height building. coverage==1 cells are finite; building==0 means surveyed open (top==ground), building==1 means an obstacle (height>0). Consumers must choose their own explicit policy for unknown cells.
notes: The provider classified no buildings in this collection (only unclassified, ground, noise, bridge), so the obstacle mask is every non-ground surface return >= 3 m above local ground: buildings AND tree canopy, vehicles-on-structures and other surface objects. It is an obstacle surface, not a building inventory. max-per-cell structure top over a 10 m cell (conservative: any structure in the cell blocks it); lidar nominal spacing at EPT depth 10; structure heights are lower bounds for spires and masts; isolated spikes >60 m and 3x above all neighbours are repaired as classification noise; classification is the provider's
